status: Proposed mathematics and offline reference values; requires independent Phase-2 implementation checks.

reference_method.name: adaptive Dormand-Prince embedded 5(4)
reference_method.independent_audit: classical RK4, fixed 5 s step, same 1e-4 m / 1e-8 m s^-1 comparison limits

conventions.coordinates: planar Cartesian inertial; right handed x,y; prograde means +z angular momentum
conventions.reference_length: One universal r0 for every interacting pair; not reset at a new encounter or for a new body.
conventions.test_particle: ship has zero gravitational source mass; no thrust, drag, collisions or softening in these vectors
conventions.tolerance: absolute SI error; arrays compared component by component; scalar tolerance applies to every component
conventions.closed_form_at_t: 0 is evaluation time only; near-circular angles are analytic limits
conventions.binary_specific_invariants: binary energy and angular momentum divided by total binary mass; mass weights GM_i/sum(GM_i)
conventions.ship_jacobi_constant: C = -2*Phi - |v_inertial|^2 + 2*omega*(x*vy-y*vx); valid only for a circular binary of constant omega
conventions.invariant_expectations: same analytic initial invariant repeated at each checkpoint; not the numerically drifted value
